simple.meaning: פְּדוּת (pᵉdûwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “distinction ; also deliverance.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: פְּדוּת (H6304) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 8:19, with occurrences in Exodus, Psalms, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פְּדוּת (H6304) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in פְּדוּת (H6304) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: פְּדוּת (pᵉdûwth) / H6304 is traced through Exodus 8:19, Psalms 111:9, Psalms 130:7, Isaiah 50:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6304. peduth מְּדוּת noun feminine ransom ; ׳פ Psa 111:9 2 t.; מְּדֻת Exod 8:19 ; — from exile Isa 50:2 ; from iniquities Psa 130:7 ; in General 111:9 , עַמֶּ֑ךָ וּבֵין עַמִּי בֵּין פְדֻת שַׂמְתִּי Exod 8:19 I will set a ransom (distinguishing) between my people and thy people ᵑ7 , but improbable and text dubious; ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 set a distinction (reading what ?).

occurrences.englishText: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
He has sent redemption to his people.
Why, when I came, was there no one?
